enrolment is complete for the users of each release-required device, a reference sheet is at the device, and a champion is named per floor
revisit_triggers: staff turnover, a new department or a shift not covered by the original passes
post-install evidence shows work still routing to displaced or surviving devices
a recurring ticket pattern points at a task users were never shown

nodes.definition: Capture and document the opening counters of every installed device on the day it goes live, per register — mono, colour, and any large-format or tiered counter the agreement bills against — with the serial, the date, the reading method and a legible capture such as the device's own printed usage report attached to the record. A new device rarely reads zero: factory test pages, a demonstration history on a floor model, pages from a pre-delivery configuration and staging run, or a refurbished unit's prior life all arrive as counts on the register, and if that opening number is not recorded the client is billed for pages that were printed before the device was theirs. Both parties acknowledge the baseline in writing alongside the acceptance document, and the same record states which register each billing element will read, so that the first invoice can be reconciled against a number both sides already agreed rather than against a number one side produces later. The baseline is also the reference the stabilization review measures realized volume against. A missing, undated or unsigned baseline is the single most common root cause of a first-invoice dispute in this business, and it is entirely preventable in the ten minutes it takes to print and sign the report.

included: opening counters per register and serial with date and method
attached legible capture such as a printed usage report
written acknowledgement by both parties
the register-to-billing-element mapping
staging and demonstration pages accounted for
excluded: producing invoices and reconciling billing periods, which the economics knowledge base owns
meter collection cadence after activation
adjusting agreed rates or allowances

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a device swap, counter reset or billing-register change requires a fresh acknowledged opening reading

pros.claim: A signed opening reading makes the first invoice reconcilable and removes the most common early dispute outright
pros.example: a device that arrived with staging pages on its register, recorded and acknowledged before it produced a single client page

pros.claim: The same record gives the stabilization review its measurement origin
pros.example: first-period volume computed as a clean delta from the acknowledged opening reading

cons.claim: The capture happens at the busiest moment of the install and is easy to defer into a note that never gets signed
cons.example: a crew finishing at closing time with the usage report printed but nobody left to sign it

cons.claim: Register naming differs by model, so a baseline captured carelessly can record numbers the invoice will never read
cons.example: capturing total impressions on a model whose agreement bills mono and colour registers separately

failure_modes: recording no opening reading because 'a new device starts at zero'
capturing a reading with no date, no serial or no witness
recording registers that the agreement does not bill and omitting the ones it does
leaving the record in a technician's photos instead of the acceptance package
acceptance_tests: every installed device has an opening reading per billed register with serial, date, method and an attached legible capture
the baseline is acknowledged in writing by the client and filed with the acceptance package before the first billable page
revisit_triggers: a device is swapped, its board is replaced or its counters are reset
the agreement changes which register a billing element reads
a first-period invoice does not reconcile to the recorded baseline

nodes.definition: Restate the agreement's mechanics in plain language at the moment of acceptance, in front of the person signing, and record that it happened. The items restated are precisely the ones this industry is criticized for burying: the length of the term and what the periodic payment does and does not cover; whether the agreement continues automatically at the end of the term unless notice is given, and exactly what that notice requires in window and in form; what ending the agreement early involves; what the end-of-term options are and by what mechanism a purchase amount would be determined rather than what that amount will be; and the condition, accessories, packaging and freight the equipment must be returned in, since return conditions are where end-of-term charges are generated. The restatement is delivered without pressure and without fear-selling, and it invites questions rather than closing them. Nothing here replaces the written agreement or constitutes legal advice: the client is told plainly that the written document governs, that this is a summary in ordinary language, and that having their own advisor review it is a reasonable thing to do. The disclosure is then logged with date, attendees and the items covered, so that it is provable rather than merely remembered.

included: plain-language restatement of term, continuation, notice window and form, early exit, end-of-term options and the purchase-amount mechanism, and return conditions
delivery without pressure and with questions invited
the statement that the written agreement governs and independent review is reasonable
a dated disclosure log with attendees and items covered
excluded: legal interpretation or advice on the agreement's effect
negotiating or amending terms, which sits with the sales agreement and the funder
stating any specific buyout figure, payment or charge as fact

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: an amended agreement, a change of signer, or a client question after acceptance requires the restatement to be repeated and re-logged

pros.claim: Restating continuation and notice in plain language at acceptance removes the industry's signature complaint before it can form
pros.example: a client hearing at signature exactly what notice the agreement requires and when the window opens, and writing it into their own calendar

pros.claim: A dated disclosure log turns a good practice into evidence that survives staff turnover on both sides
pros.example: a log naming the attendees and the items covered, filed with the acceptance package

cons.claim: An honest restatement can reopen a deal at the last moment, which is uncomfortable for everyone in the room
cons.example: a signer who pauses on hearing the notice requirement and wants to consult the owner before signing

cons.claim: Restatement is a summary and can never be complete, so it must point back to the document rather than replace it
cons.example: a question about a specific clause that has to be answered by reading the agreement itself

failure_modes: letting the restatement drift into legal interpretation or a promise about how a clause will be applied
presenting the summary as if it replaced the written agreement
restating terms to whoever is available rather than to the person with authority to sign
logging that disclosure happened without recording which items were actually covered
acceptance_tests: the disclosure log records date, attendees and each restated item: term, continuation and notice window and form, early exit, end-of-term options and purchase mechanism, and return conditions
the log records that the client was told the written agreement governs and that independent review is available to them, with no specific figure asserted as fact
revisit_triggers: the agreement is amended, replaced or a schedule is added
the signer changes or states they lack authority
the client raises a question about a term at or after acceptance

nodes.definition: Gate the job from installation to account before anyone declares it finished, using a checklist concrete enough that a technician cannot pass it by feel. Every device on the signed design is physically placed, powered and reachable; every print queue and every scan destination has been tested from a user seat; enrolment is complete where release is required; the baseline meters are captured and acknowledged; supply fulfilment is registered with the correct address, contact and par level; service coverage and the response terms are activated in the dispatch system with the client's escalation contacts and site notes loaded; displaced equipment is gone with sanitization evidence and proof of delivery on file; and the plain-language term restatement is logged. Only then is the billing start date set, and it is set to what actually happened rather than to the delivery paperwork's optimistic date. The handoff package to the account team carries the design and its evidence, the baseline meters, the coverage and response terms as written, the IT and configuration record, the training and champion list, and every open item with an owner and a date. An open item is either closed or written into the handoff; it is never left in a technician's memory or a rep's inbox.

included: the item-by-item definition of done
billing start set to actual completion
dispatch-system activation with escalation contacts and site notes
the handoff package contents
open items with owners and dates
excluded: invoice production and billing operations
renewal, upgrade and end-of-term decisions
the ongoing account relationship after handoff

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: an open item closes, a gate item is found unmet, or the client disputes the recorded completion or billing start

pros.claim: A concrete gate converts 'the install is done' from an opinion into a checkable state with a signature behind it
pros.example: an acceptance held open because one department's scan destination had never been opened by a user in that department

pros.claim: Setting the billing start to actual completion rather than to the delivery date keeps the first invoice defensible
pros.example: billing starting three days after delivery because the mail relay change landed in the next change window

cons.claim: A strict gate delays revenue recognition and creates pressure from everyone whose number depends on the month closing
cons.example: an install completed on the last day of a month with one open item that pushes activation into the next

cons.claim: Checklists can be signed mechanically, so the gate is only as strong as the culture that runs it
cons.example: a crew ticking scan-tested without a user in the department having opened the file

failure_modes: declaring completion with open items carried in someone's memory
setting the billing start from the delivery paperwork rather than from actual completion
activating coverage in the dispatch system without escalation contacts or site notes
handing off to the account team without the evidence, baselines and configuration record
acceptance_tests: every gate item is individually confirmed and dated, with the client's acceptance recorded against the signed design
the handoff package contains the design and evidence, baseline meters, coverage and response terms, configuration record, training list and every open item with an owner and date
revisit_triggers: an open item passes its committed date
a gate item is discovered to have been signed without being done
the client disputes the billing start date or the completion state

nodes.definition: Come back after the fleet has run a full billing period and compare what the assessment predicted with what the counters now say. Pull the period's meter deltas per device from the acknowledged baseline and set them against the design's typical and peak figures. A placement running far under its assessed volume almost always means the work is still going somewhere else — a surviving desktop printer, a department that was never enrolled, a scan path people quietly gave up on — while a placement running far over means the assessment missed a workflow, a department moved, or a neighbouring device is down and its work has relocated. Read the service tickets and the informal complaint log for the pattern that repeats rather than the loudest single event, since in this business the repeating pattern is most often a scan destination that broke when a credential rotated or a certificate expired. Where variance sits outside the band the design stated, re-open sizing or placement now, while the relationship is new and a change is cheap, instead of letting the client live for years with a device that does not fit. Findings and corrections are written back into the design record and handed to the account team so the annuity is managed against reality rather than against the original proposal.

included: first-period counter deltas measured from the acknowledged baseline
variance against the design's typical and peak figures with diagnosis of where work went
repeating ticket and complaint patterns
the decision rule for re-opening sizing or placement
write-back into the design record and handoff to the account team
excluded: ongoing billing, margin and cost-control review, which the economics knowledge base owns
renewal, upgrade and end-of-term planning
commercial renegotiation of rates or allowances

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a new period of realized counters, ticket data or a client complaint changes the variance picture for a placement

pros.claim: Comparing realized counters against the design catches a mis-sized placement while a correction is still inexpensive and goodwill is high
pros.example: a device running at a fraction of its assessed volume traced to a department that never got enrolled, corrected in the first period

pros.claim: Reading the repeating ticket pattern finds configuration decay that no single complaint would surface
pros.example: three separate 'scanning is broken' calls that were one expired certificate

cons.claim: One period is a small sample and a seasonal client can look mis-sized when it is merely out of season
cons.example: a school reviewed over a summer period that shows little of the volume the design was built for

cons.claim: Post-install review costs unbilled time and has no immediate revenue attached to it
cons.example: a return visit and an analysis afternoon on an account that has just started paying

failure_modes: reviewing volume without reference to the acknowledged baseline so the delta is meaningless
treating a seasonal trough as a sizing error
logging findings without writing them back into the design record
letting a known mis-fit stand because raising it is awkward so soon after signature
acceptance_tests: first-period deltas per device are computed from the acknowledged baseline and compared against the design's typical and peak figures with variance stated
every variance outside the stated band and every repeating ticket pattern has a written disposition, and findings are written back into the design record and handed to the account team
revisit_triggers: variance outside the design's stated band in any reviewed period
a repeating ticket pattern that points at configuration or enablement
a client complaint about fit, uptime or a device that is not being used

edges.why_related: the charter's site, floor and department scope is what the inventory walk is bounded by
the charter names the departments and access windows that make the workflow interviews and observation possible
counters can only be matched to devices when every device already has a serial and a metered-and-reachable flag
normalization operates on dated counter readings, so it cannot start before the readings and their grades exist
the mono, colour, duplex and media split is taken from the same normalized period the volume table is built on
what the environment can enforce technically shapes how an obligation class becomes a device requirement
the typical and peak monthly figures are the inputs that place a device inside its recommended volume band
which users a placement serves and how far they walk decides how many devices the volume should be divided across
the proposal is the written form of the sizing decision plus its evidence and user-visible consequences
coverage is written against the specific models and configurations the signed design places
the response clock and escalation ladder are the service half of the same agreement the coverage scope defines
the readiness check is run against the exact placements, models and configurations the design fixes
integration executes the print path, addressing and authentication methods discovery confirmed with the client's IT owner
the baseline must capture exactly the registers the coverage definition says the bill will read
the gate cannot set a billing start date without an acknowledged opening reading to bill from
a logged plain-language restatement is one of the gate items acceptance is not allowed to pass without
the review measures the first period from the acceptance state, its baseline and its recorded open items
the guardrail bounds what sizing may propose by requiring every class, speed step and feature to trace to measured volume or mapped work
release, destination-restriction and storage requirements are constraints the design must carry rather than options it may offer
which destinations may be configured at all, and whether release is mandatory, is fixed by the obligation classes before configuration begins
the sanitization method and the evidence required for a device leaving the building are set by the obligation class, not by crew convenience
the measured mono, colour, duplex and media mix is what forces the agreement to define what counts as a page and which registers bill
colour share, coverage character and special media change which class and configuration the same page total requires
measured volume against replenishment lead time is the mechanism that sets a par level rather than habit
the device must be in its final spot on a live drop before addressing, queues and destinations can be configured and tested
training and enrolment only work once the paths users are being trained on actually function from their seats
the removal path and its sequencing against the incoming device are settled in the readiness check and executed on the same visit
the opening reading is taken on the device in place on go-live day, after staging and configuration pages have already registered
sizing wants headroom for a future the counters have not yet shown, while the guardrail refuses capacity that no evidence justifies
edges.resolution_rule: headroom is allowed up to the peak month contained in the evidence plus the band the design states; anything beyond that is removed from the recommended design and shown separately as an optional upgrade with its monthly consequence named, and any growth the client asserts is recorded as a written assumption rather than treated as measured volume

edges.why_related: consolidating volume onto fewer devices lowers fleet overhead while the walk map argues for proximity and a fallback
edges.resolution_rule: consolidate only where the resulting walk stays inside the limit agreed with the client and a named fallback device or written extended-downtime commitment exists for that placement; otherwise keep the second device and state the difference in the design

edges.why_related: release at the device and restricted destinations protect the client's documents while adding friction that pushes users back to unmanaged printers
edges.resolution_rule: where an obligation class requires release or destination restriction the control wins and the friction is answered by enrolling users during training and naming a floor champion, never by disabling the control; where no class requires it the client chooses with the friction and the exposure both stated

edges.why_related: competitive pressure pushes for a faster written response term than the dealer's technician density and travel geography can actually staff
edges.resolution_rule: the written commitment may not exceed what the service geography can staff for this address; where the client needs more, the answer is an on-site spare, a loaner trigger or a different coverage structure priced as such, never a promise the dispatch log will show as missed

edges.why_related: waiting for a second dated counter reading collides with the proposal date the sales cycle has already promised
edges.resolution_rule: the charter's stop condition holds: a design delivered before counter evidence exists is labelled estimate-grade per placement on the face of the document, the label may not be removed to strengthen the proposal, and the design is reissued once the readings arrive

edges.why_related: the install day wants a signature and a billing start, while an honest restatement of continuation, notice and return conditions can reopen questions
edges.resolution_rule: disclosure always precedes signature; if the restatement raises a question that cannot be answered from the written agreement, acceptance is held and the question is routed to the agreement owner rather than signed around, and the hold is recorded as an open item with an owner and date

edges.why_related: standardizing on one model family simplifies service, training and consumables while some departments' mapped work does not fit the standard device
edges.resolution_rule: standardization holds unless a mapped workflow requirement physically fails on the standard device, in which case the exception is documented on that placement page with the job that justifies it and the consumable and training consequence of the exception is stated

edges.why_related: realized first-period counters measured from the baseline are the only real test of the sizing decision and can re-open it
the repeating ticket pattern after go-live is usually a decayed credential, certificate or destination that integration must repair and re-record
a placement running far under its assessed volume points at departments that were never enrolled or trained and need another pass
both are dated serial-level records of physical devices produced by the same discipline, one of the fleet being replaced and one of the fleet being started

conflict_axes.name: measured_evidence_vs_proposal_deadline
conflict_axes.description: Counter evidence takes read intervals and IT consent to accumulate, while the sales cycle wants a fleet design this week; the temptation is to present inferred pages as if they were counted.
poles: deliver the design on the sales calendar
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: deliver early only with per-placement estimate-grade labelling that survives into the proposal, and reissue the design when the readings land

conflict_axes.name: growth_headroom_vs_no_oversell
conflict_axes.description: Headroom protects a client whose volume grows, and it is also the mechanism by which capacity nobody needs gets placed under a multi-year obligation.
poles: size for the growth the client expects
size for the volume the evidence shows
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: cover the documented peak, put anything beyond it in a separately shown option with its monthly consequence, and write asserted growth down as an assumption

conflict_axes.name: consolidation_savings_vs_uptime_and_walk
conflict_axes.description: Fewer, larger devices concentrate volume where the unit cost is lowest and simultaneously create longer walks and a single point of failure for everyone behind them.
poles: keep devices close to the people
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: consolidate only inside the agreed walk limit and only with a named fallback device or a written extended-downtime commitment

conflict_axes.name: security_control_vs_user_friction
conflict_axes.description: Release at the device, restricted destinations and credential requirements remove real exposure and add steps that users route around if nobody enrols and trains them.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: where an obligation class requires the control it stays and enrolment plus a floor champion absorb the friction; elsewhere the client decides with both the friction and the exposure stated

conflict_axes.name: standardization_vs_workflow_fit
conflict_axes.description: One model family across a building simplifies service, stocking and training, while individual departments carry jobs that the standard device cannot physically do.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: standardize by default and document each exception on its placement page with the job that justifies it and the stocking and training cost it adds

conflict_axes.name: install_day_speed_vs_disclosure_completeness
conflict_axes.description: Every incentive on install day points at signature and a billing start, while the restatement of continuation, notice and return conditions is exactly the conversation that can slow the day down.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: disclosure precedes signature without exception; an unanswerable question holds acceptance and becomes a recorded open item rather than being signed around

conflict_axes.name: promised_response_vs_service_geography
conflict_axes.description: A uniform response promise sells well and is dishonest wherever technician density and travel time cannot support it.
poles: write what the territory can staff
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: write the achievable term with its measurement method and answer a client's need for more with a spare, a loaner trigger or a different structure that is priced

conflict_axes.name: supply_availability_vs_stranded_stock
conflict_axes.description: Deep on-site par levels prevent stockouts and produce shelves of model-specific cartridges that become worthless the moment a device is replaced or relocated.
poles: hold the minimum that covers lead time
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: derive the par level from this device's measured volume and the actual replenishment lead time, and revise it when realized consumption differs

conflict_axes.name: it_control_vs_deployment_schedule
conflict_axes.description: The client's change windows, security reviews and authentication policies protect their environment and rarely align with a delivery date already booked with a carrier.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: book delivery to the change window rather than the reverse, and hold configuration rather than working around a control the client's IT owns

conflict_axes.name: simple_coverage_story_vs_precise_page_definition
conflict_axes.description: An inclusive-sounding coverage promise is easier to sell than a precise definition of what counts as a page and which register the invoice reads, and it is also what produces the first-year dispute.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: write inclusions, exclusions, the page definition and the billed registers together and show the structure against this client's own measured volume

edge_cases.description: A device's counters are reset to zero by a mainboard replacement in the middle of the evidence period, so the delta reads as a negative or an impossible number
edge_cases.trigger: a service event resets or replaces a counter register between two readings
edge_cases.mitigation: recover the pre-replacement reading from the service record, treat the period as two segments with their own day counts, and mark the affected figure with a lower evidence grade

edge_cases.description: A newly delivered device arrives with counts already on its registers because it is a refurbished unit, a demonstration floor model, or was staged and configured before delivery
edge_cases.trigger: install-day counter reading is not zero
edge_cases.mitigation: record and acknowledge the opening reading exactly as found with the printed usage report attached, and state in the acceptance package that billing runs from that acknowledged number rather than from zero

edge_cases.description: The whole evidence window falls inside the client's quiet season, so the measured volume represents none of the months the fleet actually has to carry
edge_cases.trigger: assessment period sits in a documented seasonal trough such as a school summer or a post-filing month
edge_cases.mitigation: recover an earlier dated reading from service or billing history to reach a peak month, or design to the peak the client can document and label the seasonal uncertainty on the placement page

edge_cases.description: The client's security review refuses any data-collection agent on the network, so no automated counter or supply telemetry is available
edge_cases.trigger: IT declines agent installation or blocks outbound device telemetry
edge_cases.mitigation: schedule hand reads at the panel and printed usage reports on an agreed cadence, record the evidence grade honestly, and replace automatic supply fulfilment with a named ordering contact and trigger written at the device

edge_cases.description: Scan to email stops working weeks after go-live because the mail tenant tightened its authentication requirement or the service account password rotated
edge_cases.trigger: a credential, protocol or certificate the device depends on changes after the install
edge_cases.mitigation: keep the configuration record naming every device, destination, service account and certificate expiry so the fix is a lookup, and treat repeat scan tickets in the stabilization review as one configuration defect rather than several user complaints

edge_cases.description: A department runs tabloid sheets, window envelopes or heavy label stock a few times a month and nobody mentioned it, so the standardized device cannot feed the work
edge_cases.trigger: a low-frequency but mandatory media requirement surfaces after the design is signed
edge_cases.mitigation: reopen that placement page as a documented standardization exception with the job that justifies it, or designate a named alternate device for that media with the walk stated, and record the stocking and training consequence

edge_cases.description: The crated device with its finisher does not fit the freight elevator or the copy-room doorway, and the building's freight elevator is booked out for weeks
edge_cases.trigger: delivery path dimensions or building access are discovered to be inadequate on the day
edge_cases.mitigation: measure the path against crated dimensions and book access before the truck is booked; where it still fails, plan a de-crate and re-assembly point or reschedule rather than forcing the device through and damaging it or the building

edge_cases.description: The displaced device belongs to another party whose agreement carries strict return conditions on packaging, accessories, freight destination and final meter
edge_cases.trigger: removal of equipment that this dealer does not own
edge_cases.mitigation: obtain the written return instruction from the party that owns the decision, ship exactly to the named destination with the required accessories and a final meter reading, and keep serial-level proof of delivery in the acceptance package

edge_cases.description: Users keep printing to a surviving desktop printer, so the new placement runs at a fraction of its assessed volume while the shadow device absorbs the work
edge_cases.trigger: first-period counters show a placement far under its design figure
edge_cases.mitigation: trace the missing pages to the device actually producing them, run another enablement and enrolment pass for that department, and reconsider the placement or the walk rather than assuming the users will change

edge_cases.description: The person available to sign at acceptance is not the person with authority over the agreement, and the authority holder later learns of the continuation clause for the first time
edge_cases.trigger: an office manager or coordinator is offered the acceptance document to sign
edge_cases.mitigation: confirm signing authority against the charter's named signer, deliver the plain-language restatement to that person, and send the same written restatement to the authority holder before billing starts rather than after

edge_cases.description: A device is placed in a shared suite or a corridor where another tenant's staff and visitors walk past the output tray
edge_cases.trigger: the only physically viable placement sits outside the client's controlled space
edge_cases.mitigation: require release at the device for that placement so nothing prints until its owner is standing there, and record the exposure and the control in the design rather than leaving it to users to manage

edge_cases.description: Toner shipped to the client's central receiving dock never reaches the department and the device runs out mid-week
edge_cases.trigger: a supply delivery is signed for at a dock and not forwarded to the device's floor
edge_cases.mitigation: record the receiving contact, internal routing and storage location per placement at activation, and treat a stockout caused by internal routing as a fulfilment defect to be fixed in the record rather than a one-off delivery

workflow.action: Agree the assessment charter and its stop condition
workflow.description: Fix the in-scope sites and departments, the counter evidence period, the data access required, the client signer and the estimate-grade rule
workflow.gate: sites, departments, evidence period, required access, signer, stop condition and the estimate-grade labelling rule are all written and acknowledged

workflow.action: Walk the floors and inventory every device
workflow.description: Record make, model, serial, location, network identity, ownership and lease status and the metered-and-reachable flag, including the shadow fleet
workflow.artifact: serial-level device inventory with ownership status
workflow.gate: every device seen on the floor plan has a serial, a location, an ownership status and a metered flag, and shadow devices are listed with their departments

workflow.action: Collect counter evidence and grade it
workflow.description: Capture dated readings per register by panel, embedded page, usage report or agent, and apply the degradation ladder where no counter exists
workflow.artifact: counter evidence table with registers, sources, dates and evidence grades
workflow.gate: each device has two dated readings, a dated prior plus current reading, or a written reason and a grade below counter level

workflow.action: Normalize volume and name the seasonality
workflow.description: Divide deltas by actual days, re-express monthly, segment interrupted periods and isolate one-off events to produce typical and peak figures
workflow.artifact: per-placement volume table with typical and peak figures
workflow.gate: every figure is traceable to dated readings and no partial or interrupted period has been averaged through

workflow.action: Split the page mix by class and media
workflow.description: Separate mono and colour, characterize coverage, record duplex ratio, sheet sizes, special media and scan volume, verifying any tiered counting on the model
workflow.gate: registers are named, tiered colour counting is verified rather than assumed, and special media and scan volume are recorded

workflow.description: Record each department's recurring jobs, timing, scan destinations and permissions, finishing and media needs, and work flowing to or from outside print
workflow.gate: every department has recorded jobs, destinations with permission owners, finishing and media requirements and a named contact

workflow.action: Discover the IT environment and fix the obligation classes
workflow.description: Confirm print path, addressing, mail and file-share authentication, service accounts, certificates, change window and the named IT owner, then classify the document obligations with the client's compliance owner
workflow.gate: the IT owner has confirmed the print and scan path and change window, and every document type carries an obligation class with a verify-locally note

workflow.action: Right-size the fleet under the justification guardrail
workflow.description: Place each device inside its recommended volume band at the documented peak, set speed from arrival pattern, evaluate consolidation with a named fallback, and drop anything the evidence does not justify
workflow.gate: every class, speed step and feature traces to measured volume or a mapped workflow requirement, and every consolidation names its fallback

workflow.description: Publish per-placement class, configuration, evidence, walk, removals, user-visible changes, assumptions and the recommended-versus-optional split for client signature
workflow.gate: every placement page carries evidence with its grade and user-visible changes, optional items are separated, and the removal list names every displaced serial

workflow.action: Define coverage, response and supply terms
workflow.description: Write inclusions, exclusions, the page definition and billed registers, the volume structure as a mechanism against measured volume, the response clock and escalation, and the replenishment and par-level setup
workflow.artifact: service coverage, response and supply activation record
workflow.gate: page definition and billed registers are stated per model, the response clock and measurement method are defined, and every device has a replenishment trigger, par level and delivery contact

workflow.action: Confirm site readiness and execute the delivery and removal
workflow.description: Verify measured path, access bookings, floor loading, clearances, live drop and power, align with the IT change window, deliver, and remove displaced equipment with sanitization evidence
workflow.artifact: site readiness checklist and removal record with sanitization evidence
workflow.gate: readiness is confirmed in writing per placement before the truck is booked, and every removed device has a serial-level sanitization and destination record

workflow.action: Integrate, enable users, then run the acceptance gate
workflow.description: Configure queues, defaults, release and every scan destination and test them from user seats, train and enrol each department, capture and acknowledge baseline meters, deliver and log the plain-language term restatement, then set the billing start and hand off
workflow.artifact: acceptance package with baseline meters, disclosure log, configuration record and open items
workflow.gate: every gate item is individually confirmed and dated, the baseline and disclosure log are signed, and the billing start reflects actual completion

priority_rationale: The charter, the serial-level inventory and the graded counter evidence come first because every later decision in this subdomain is defended by them; normalization and page-mix analysis turn those readings into figures a design can stand on; the no-oversell guardrail is fixed before sizing so it constrains the design rather than auditing it afterwards; sizing, the workflow and placement maps, the IT environment and the document obligation classes converge into one signed design document that everything downstream executes against; coverage, response and supply terms are written against that specific fleet; delivery, removal, integration and enablement carry it into the building; and the baseline meter, the plain-language term restatement and the acceptance gate come last because they are what makes the placement billable, disclosed and defensible, with the stabilization review closing the loop back onto sizing and configuration.

dominance_rules.rule: Document-confidentiality and device-storage obligations dominate speed, cost and convenience in every configuration and removal decision
dominance_rules.rationale: a device that leaves with client documents on it, or output that sits in a corridor tray, is the client's exposure and not a service ticket the dealer can absorb
dominance_rules.trigger: any configuration, placement or removal choice that would weaken a control an obligation class requires
dominance_rules.action: hold the choice, apply the control the class requires, and record the requirement and its verify-locally note in the design

dominance_rules.rule: Measured counter evidence dominates recollection, estimates and vendor assumptions wherever the two disagree
dominance_rules.rationale: every sizing and coverage decision in this business is defended later by the readings behind it, not by what anyone remembered in a meeting
dominance_rules.trigger: a client's stated volume, a prior proposal or a manufacturer assumption conflicts with dated counter readings
dominance_rules.action: use the counter evidence, record the discrepancy in the design, and keep the estimate-grade label on anything not counted

dominance_rules.rule: The no-oversell justification guardrail dominates the fleet design whenever capacity cannot be traced to evidence
dominance_rules.rationale: an over-sized device under a signed multi-year obligation is a cost the client generally cannot exit, while an under-sized one is a fixable service problem
dominance_rules.trigger: a proposed class, speed step, finisher or feature has no measured volume or mapped workflow behind it
dominance_rules.action: remove it from the recommended design or move it to a separately shown option with its monthly consequence stated

dominance_rules.rule: Plain-language term restatement dominates the install schedule and the billing calendar
dominance_rules.rationale: buried continuation, notice and return conditions are this vertical's reputation problem, and disclosure that happens after signature is not disclosure
dominance_rules.trigger: acceptance is about to be signed or a billing start is about to be set
dominance_rules.action: deliver and log the restatement first; if a question cannot be answered from the written agreement, hold acceptance and record an open item with an owner and date

dominance_rules.rule: An acknowledged baseline meter dominates the technician's departure and the first invoice
dominance_rules.rationale: an unsigned or missing opening reading is the most common root cause of a first-invoice dispute and is preventable in minutes
dominance_rules.trigger: a device is about to produce billable pages without a signed opening reading per billed register
dominance_rules.action: capture the reading with its printed report, obtain written acknowledgement, and file it with the acceptance package before billing starts

dominance_rules.rule: An end-to-end test from a user's seat dominates any test performed at the device panel
dominance_rules.rationale: the failure that matters is a document that does not reach a person who can open it, which a panel test cannot detect
dominance_rules.trigger: a print queue or scan destination is about to be marked working
dominance_rules.action: have a user in the owning department produce and open the output before the item is signed off

dominance_rules.rule: Achievable response terms dominate competitive pressure to match a rival's promise
dominance_rules.rationale: a commitment the dispatch geography cannot staff converts every future service call into evidence against the dealer
dominance_rules.trigger: a proposed response term exceeds what technician density and travel time can support for this address
dominance_rules.action: write the achievable term with its measurement method and offer a spare, loaner trigger or different structure as the priced answer to a stricter need

dominance_rules.rule: The physical walk dominates the client's asset list wherever the two disagree
dominance_rules.rationale: asset lists omit exactly the shadow devices whose unmeasured pages distort the whole design
dominance_rules.trigger: a device is on the floor but not on the client's list, or on the list but not on the floor
dominance_rules.action: correct the inventory from the walk, note the discrepancy, and re-check whether the affected pages were counted anywhere

dominance_rules.rule: Naming an obligation class and directing verification dominates asserting a specific rule
dominance_rules.rationale: data-protection, retention and disposal requirements differ by jurisdiction and change, and a confident wrong statement is worse than a correct pointer
dominance_rules.trigger: a question arises about what a regulation, retention period or disposal duty specifically requires
dominance_rules.action: name the class, route it to the client's compliance owner, and record the requirement with a verify-current-rules-in-your-jurisdiction note

dominance_rules.rule: A named uptime fallback dominates consolidation savings on any placement that would otherwise stand alone
dominance_rules.rationale: concentrating a floor onto one device turns a routine failure into a stoppage for everyone behind it
dominance_rules.trigger: a consolidation would leave a department with no alternate device inside the agreed walk
dominance_rules.action: designate the fallback device or write the extended-downtime commitment into the service terms before the consolidation is proposed

anti_rework_rules.rule: Agree the charter, its sites and its evidence period before walking any floor
anti_rework_rules.prevents: re-walks, scope arguments and an assessment that cannot say when it is finished

anti_rework_rules.rule: Complete the serial-level inventory before pulling any counter
anti_rework_rules.prevents: readings that cannot be matched to a device and page totals with no owner

anti_rework_rules.rule: Obtain two dated readings, or a dated prior reading, before sizing anything
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a fleet designed on lifetime totals that has to be redesigned when real deltas appear

anti_rework_rules.rule: Normalize per day and name the seasonality before comparing placements or choosing classes
anti_rework_rules.prevents: devices sized to a partial period or to a quiet season and replaced within the first year

anti_rework_rules.rule: Settle the print path, authentication methods and obligation classes with IT and the compliance owner before equipment is ordered
anti_rework_rules.prevents: devices that arrive and cannot scan, and configurations rebuilt after a security review says no

anti_rework_rules.rule: Confirm the measured delivery path, floor loading, live drop, power and access booking before the truck is booked
anti_rework_rules.prevents: failed deliveries, crates in hallways, damaged equipment and a second freight charge

anti_rework_rules.rule: Define coverage inclusions, exclusions, the page definition and the billed registers before the agreement is signed
anti_rework_rules.prevents: the first-invoice dispute and a renegotiation that starts the relationship in the wrong place

anti_rework_rules.rule: Capture and acknowledge the baseline meter before the device produces a billable page
anti_rework_rules.prevents: billing a client for staging and demonstration pages and an unwinnable argument about the opening number

anti_rework_rules.rule: Deliver and log the plain-language term restatement before the acceptance signature
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a continuation or return-condition surprise that costs the account and the referral network around it

anti_rework_rules.rule: Enrol users and test every scan destination from a user seat before the crew leaves the site
anti_rework_rules.prevents: return visits for paths that were never really working and departments that quietly revert to old devices

iteration_protocol.trigger: first-period counters differ from the design's typical or peak figure beyond the stated band
iteration_protocol.action: diagnose where the pages actually went, then re-open sizing or placement while the change is still cheap and write the correction back into the design record

iteration_protocol.trigger: a scan or print path fails after go-live because a credential, certificate, protocol version or tenant policy changed
iteration_protocol.action: repair the path with the client's IT owner from the configuration record and update that record and the certificate expiry list

iteration_protocol.trigger: a device, department or site is discovered that the inventory and evidence never covered
iteration_protocol.action: extend the inventory and counter collection to it and reissue the affected placement pages of the design

iteration_protocol.trigger: the client's compliance owner, records system or a policy audit changes a document obligation
iteration_protocol.action: re-derive the device requirements for the affected placements and reconfigure release, destinations or storage handling accordingly

iteration_protocol.trigger: repeated supply stockouts or a shelf of stranded cartridges appears at a placement
iteration_protocol.action: recalculate the par level from realized consumption and lead time and fix the delivery contact, routing and storage location in the record

iteration_protocol.trigger: response commitments are being missed for this client or this territory
iteration_protocol.action: re-examine the written term against actual dispatch data and either restructure the commitment honestly or add the spare or loaner arrangement that makes it achievable

iteration_protocol.trigger: a client raises a question about term, continuation, notice or return conditions at or after acceptance
iteration_protocol.action: repeat the plain-language restatement to the person with authority, route anything the written agreement does not settle to the agreement owner, and re-log the disclosure

iteration_protocol.trigger: work is still routing to surviving desktop or displaced devices after go-live
iteration_protocol.action: run another enablement and enrolment pass for the affected department and reconsider the placement or walk rather than waiting for behaviour to change
